address: 3325 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109

zones.label: VIP 1
zones.description: VIP 1 puts you very close on the left side, with strong detail on Shin Lim’s hands and expressions.

zones.label: VIP 2
zones.description: VIP 2 is the closest straight-on view. Pick it when maximum proximity matters more than having a little visual breathing room.

zones.label: VIP 3
zones.description: VIP 3 mirrors VIP 1 on the right side, keeping you close to the sleight-of-hand work.

zones.label: Section 1
zones.description: Section 1 is a strong main-floor option with a slight left angle and enough distance to take in the full presentation.

zones.label: Section 2
zones.description: Section 2 is the Vegas Sidekick Sweet Spot / Our Pick: centered on the main floor, close enough for card detail without sitting on top of the stage.

zones.label: Section 3
zones.description: Section 3 gives the same main-floor distance as Section 1 from the opposite side, with a clean view into the center of the stage.

zones.label: Section 4
zones.description: Section 4 is a wider-value angle on the left while keeping the stage comfortably in view.

zones.label: Section 5
zones.description: Section 5 moves closer to center and gives a balanced elevated view.

zones.label: Section 6
zones.description: Section 6 is the centered middle tier, useful when you want a symmetrical full-stage view.

zones.label: Section 7
zones.description: Section 7 gives a balanced elevated view just right of center.

zones.label: Section 8
zones.description: Section 8 is a wider-value angle on the right with a clear view of the whole stage.

zones.label: Section 9
zones.description: Section 9 is an upper-level value option with a broad view of the full production.

zones.label: Section 10
zones.description: Section 10 is the centered upper tier and the cleanest straight-on option in the back of the room.

zones.label: Section 11
zones.description: Section 11 mirrors Section 9 on the right and works well when price matters more than proximity.
